name: codex-wechat-bridge
description: Bridge Codex tasks to WeChat with reliable notifications, recoverable backlog reset, quote-authorized continuation, desktop-visible new tasks, branches, and attachments.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex tasks with WeChat ClawBot.
interface.longDescription: A local, Windows-native bridge that watches Codex task lifecycle events and connects them to the official WeChat ClawBot transport without requiring OpenClaw. It supports strict quote-authorized continuation, persistent new tasks, conversation branches, attachments, recoverable backlog reset, replay guards, diagnostics, and restart recovery.
defaultPrompt: Check the Codex WeChat Bridge status.
Send a WeChat bridge test notification.
Enable the controlled WeChat to Codex relay.
